title: Per-block C-reducibility lemmas collated into the four-colour the_reducibility
intent: Prove that all 633 configurations of `the_configs` are C-reducible by splitting the index range [0, 633) into ten contiguous blocks, giving one generated lemma per block (`red000to214` … `red588to633`), each itself a `CatReducible` chain of smaller generated block lemmas whose leaves close by computational reflection (`CheckReducible`).

applicability.goal_shape: A statement of the form `reducible_in_range 0 (size the_configs) the_configs` (all of a fixed, finite list satisfy a decidable predicate `cfreducible`), where the list is a long homogeneous family (`the_configs := @seqn config 633`) that can be partitioned into contiguous index blocks.
applicability.use_when: One theorem must cover a large, structured family of homogeneous cases (one per configuration, compiler pass, or function), each provable by the same mechanical procedure, and the family has a natural contiguous ordering so a transitivity-like combinator (`cat_reducible_range`) can catenate the per-block results.
applicability.avoid_when: The cases are few, or heterogeneous (each needs a distinct argument, so the shared per-block tactic buys nothing); the blocks are not contiguous or cannot be tiled exactly (the combinator requires the end of one block to equal the start of the next); the per-case check is not uniform enough to be discharged by one generated tactic.

claims.claim: The parent `the_reducibility` is closed from the ten direct lemmas in three tactic lines: line 18 unfolds `reducibility` and applies `cat_reducible_range with 322`, and lines 19-20 are two `CatReducible` chains naming `red000to214 … red302to322` (range [0, 322)) and `red322to485 … red588to633` (range [322, 633)); nothing else appears between `Proof.` and `Qed.`.

Each of the ten direct lemmas is a `CatReducible` chain of five contiguous sub-block lemmas, and every job-level sub-block lemma closes with the single tactic `CheckReducible` (computational reflection): `red000to214` cites `red000to106`, which `job001to106.v` closes with `Proof. CheckReducible. Qed.`; the one non-job argument, `red633` in `red588to633`, is the empty end range closed by `check_reducible_in_range; left`.

The shape is measured from the copied files: `direct_lemmas = 10` (the ten `redMMMtoNNN` names in reducibility.v lines 19-20), `depth = 2` (the chain the_reducibility → red000to214 → red000to106, the last closed by `CheckReducible`), `glue_lines = 5` (reducibility.v lines 17-21, the `Proof … Qed` block), and `child_lines = [3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 5]` (each shown child's `Proof … Qed` block; red588to633 has 5 because it also proves the empty end-range `red633`).
claims.evidence: counted from https://github.com/math-comp/fourcolor/blob/c1d6b1cd5288bea4b067aac13cdde3c18dffe018/theories/proof/reducibility.v#L17-L21 and the eight child sites listed under `sites`; depth chain checked in task001to214.v#L14-L17 and job001to106.v#L12-L13

claims.claim: The 633 configurations are covered by 49 job files (`theories/proof/job*.v`) grouped into the 10 task files, for a two-level tree of 60 lemmas (1 theorem + 10 task + 49 job) whose leaves are all closed by `CheckReducible`.
claims.evidence: 49 job files counted by `library/tools/list_files.py fourcolor` at commit c1d6b1cd5288bea4b067aac13cdde3c18dffe018 (paths matching theories/proof/job*.v); the_configs := @seqn config 633 at https://github.com/math-comp/fourcolor/blob/c1d6b1cd5288bea4b067aac13cdde3c18dffe018/theories/proof/configurations.v#L2076

claims.claim: The authors document the collation move in the file header: "CatReducible lem1 .. lem5 :: tactic for proving a reducible_in_range i j cfs subgoal by combining proofs lem[1-5] of reducible_in_range for five contiguous subranges covering [i, j).".

metrics.how_counted: job_lemmas = files matching theories/proof/job*.v in the list_files.py output at the pinned commit; total_lemmas = 1 theorem (the_reducibility) + 10 task lemmas + 49 job lemmas; configurations = size of the_configs, defined as @seqn config 633 in configurations.v line 2076

consequences: The move creates one leaf obligation per block (each must prove `reducible_in_range MMM NNN the_configs`), a contiguity obligation (the blocks must tile the parent range exactly, since `cat_reducible_range` needs the end of one block to equal the start of the next), and a fixed arity (the `CatReducible` tactic takes exactly five sub-lemmas, so the final `red588to633` introduces an inline `have red633` for the empty end range [633, 633)). Failure modes: a missing or overlapping block, or a block whose range is off by one, fails as an opaque unification error at the catenation point rather than a pointed message; and a block whose configurations are not all checkable by the same `CheckReducible` reflection breaks the uniform one-tactic leaf.
